title: Surfing Lessons for Kids and Teens: A Beginner’s Guide
description: Surfing lessons for kids and teens: choosing a surf school, typical ages, kit, the best UK beginner spots, inland surf lakes and staying safe.
h1: Surfing lessons for kids and teens
intro: There’s nothing like standing up on your first wave. Here’s how to get kids and teens surfing safely, from Cornwall’s beaches to inland surf lakes.

image.alt: A group of people learning to surf

cardText: Surf schools, ages, kit and the best beginner spots.

blocks.title: Scout’s surf tip
blocks.text: Book a lesson with a qualified instructor at a lifeguarded beach. They’ll pick safe conditions, and soft boards make learning much easier.
points: Bring suncream even when it’s cloudy

sections.html:
• North Cornwall and North Devon have many surf schools on beginner-friendly beaches.
  • Inland surf lakes, like The Wave near Bristol, offer consistent waves and lessons.
  • Abroad, many European beach resorts have surf schools too.
Most lessons include a soft board and wetsuit, a beach briefing and time in the shallows with an instructor. Group lessons are cheaper. Private lessons progress faster.
Surf between the black and white flags where they’re used, and never on a red flag. Read beach safety for families and see surf and paddle days out.

faqs.q: What age can kids start surfing lessons?
faqs.a: Many surf schools take children from around 8, and some run younger sessions with parents. Children should be confident swimmers.
